name: 流光随行 · LumaLink 远控伴侣
description: 免开设置窗的全功能手机远控台：支持物理局域网与内网穿透网卡一键切换、6 位配对码与手动连接参数复制、扫码二维码、HiDPI 分辨率切换、物理隐私黑屏与已配对手机管理
author: Lucent Official

commands.title: 开关流光随行远控服务
commands.subtitle: 经 Host Bridge 一键启停局域网 Bonjour 广播与远控监听

commands.title: 查看流光随行配对码与手动连接地址
commands.subtitle: 自动启动远控监听并展示 6 位安全配对码、连接 IP、控制端口与一键复制项

commands.title: 切换流光随行连接网卡与 IP
commands.subtitle: 在物理局域网 (en0/en1) 与内网穿透网卡 (Tailscale/ZeroTier/utun) 之间一键切换

commands.title: 弹出 LumaLink 扫码配对二维码
commands.subtitle: 自动启动监听并在独立看图窗弹出高清扫码配对二维码

commands.title: 切换远控护眼 HiDPI 分辨率
commands.subtitle: 在主浮窗直接浏览并切换主副屏 HiDPI 分辨率或一键恢复原生模式

commands.title: 切换 Mac 物理屏幕隐私黑屏
commands.subtitle: 远控期间关闭物理屏幕显示防窥，不影响远端画面传输

commands.title: 切换 Mac 防休眠常亮保护
commands.subtitle: 阻止空闲睡眠以保持局域网远控连接不断线

commands.title: 管理已配对手机与解绑凭证
commands.subtitle: 查看已授权手机列表并支持二次确认安全吊销单台设备 Token

commands.title: 切换 VideoToolbox RDP 硬件加速
commands.subtitle: 启停 H.264 硬件编码高帧率远程桌面侧车服务

config.label: 在主控台直接展示配对码与二维码入口
弹出扫码二维码窗口时默认置顶悬浮

en.name: LumaLink Remote Companion
en.description: Full LAN & Tunnel remote console: network/IP switcher, 6-digit pairing PIN & manual connect details, QR popup, HiDPI display switcher, privacy curtain & paired device revocation

lumalink-toggle.title: Toggle LumaLink Remote Service
lumalink-toggle.subtitle: Start or stop LAN Bonjour discovery & remote listener

lumalink-pin.title: Show Pairing PIN & Manual Connect Info
lumalink-pin.subtitle: Start listener and inspect 6-digit PIN, Host IP, and ports

lumalink-network.title: Switch Network Interface / IP
lumalink-network.subtitle: Choose between physical LAN (en0) and Tunnel/VPN (Tailscale/ZeroTier)

lumalink-qr.title: Pop Up LumaLink Pairing QR Code
lumalink-qr.subtitle: Ensure listener is active and open crisp QR code viewer

lumalink-displays.title: Switch HiDPI Display Resolution
lumalink-displays.subtitle: Switch Mac display resolution or restore native mode inline

lumalink-curtain.title: Toggle Physical Screen Privacy Curtain
lumalink-curtain.subtitle: Blank physical Mac displays during remote sessions

lumalink-caffeine.title: Toggle Sleep Prevention (Caffeine)
lumalink-caffeine.subtitle: Keep Mac awake while remote session is active

lumalink-devices.title: Manage & Revoke Paired Phones
lumalink-devices.subtitle: Inspect paired mobile devices and revoke encrypted tokens

lumalink-rdp.title: Toggle VideoToolbox RDP Engine
lumalink-rdp.subtitle: Switch hardware-accelerated H.264 remote desktop sidecar

showPairURIInCard.label: Show pairing PIN & QR launcher in main console

pinQRWindowOnTop.label: Float QR code window on top when opened
